arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of Growth and Decay at the Tree of Whispers.

Your {c_important}Witchcraft{/c} Effects deal {c_random}[SF_3*100|x%|]{/c} of the damage dealt over {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} seconds. The damage type is based on your class.{if:SF_2}

If any of your damage over time effects exceed {c_number}[SF_6*100]%{/c} of the target's total Life, they will immediately die.{/if}
